teachingQuestion: Where does assurance come from between a claimed identity and an active session?
focalInsight: Identification, proofing, authentication, authorization, and session management are linked stages, not interchangeable terms.
title: From identity claim to session
caption: Each stage adds a different kind of evidence or decision.
altSummary: A flow moves from an identity claim through proofing and registration, authentication, authorization, and bounded session management, with reauthentication possible.
textFallback: An identifier is a claim. Proofing and registration establish the identity relationship. Authentication verifies control of a bound authenticator. Authorization decides the requested action, and session controls preserve or revoke the resulting access over time.
